pull_requests.title: Finite projector overlap: close the Taylor bridge under C1 assumptions
pull_requests.description_excerpt:
PR #8 left the analytic overlap remainder outside Lean. This follow-up closes that bridge through the exact equal-trace idempotent identity: Tr((Q-P)^2) = 2k - 2 Tr(PQ). Differentiability at the base point already yields the full quadratic overlap limit; C² is a specialization.

Seven new theorems are accepted: the exact identity, normalized difference-square limit, quadratic overlap limit, quantified small-o remainder, two-sided negative-direction cap excess, necessary nonnegativity for a local cap, and a C² specialization. Local idempotency and constant real trace are explicit Lean hypotheses. The complete written proof derives local trace constancy from continuity and finite-dimensional idempotency, and also supplies the requested C² integral-Taylor argument. The integral representation and rank-local-constancy proof are written arguments, not separately formalized here.
